        public static SpotsDetector.SpotsDetectorBuilder create(int channel)
                                                 throws Imaris.Error
        Convenience method to call SpotsDetector.SpotsDetectorBuilder. Check that method for optional parameters
        Parameters:
        channel - the 0-based channel to run the spots detection on
        Returns:
        a SpotsDetector.SpotsDetectorBuilder
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error Object

      • create

        public static Imaris.ISpotsPrx create(List<mcib3d.geom.Point3D> coordinates,
                                      mcib3d.geom.Point3D radiusXYZ,
                                      Integer timepoint)
                               throws Imaris.Error
        Allows to create a spots object from the coordinate list at the given timepoint Spots objects in Imaris cannot have more coordinates added afterwards So spots for all timepoints should be made in advance and use create(List, List, List) instead
        Parameters:
        coordinates - coordinates list
        radiusXYZ - radiuses in xyz for the spots, identical for all spots
        timepoint - given timepoint
        Returns:
        an imaris spot object
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error

      • create

        public static Imaris.ISpotsPrx create(List<mcib3d.geom.Point3D> coordinates,
                                      List<mcib3d.geom.Point3D> radiiXYZ,
                                      List<Integer> timepoints)
                               throws Imaris.Error
        Create Spots object based on a list of coordinates, radii and timepoints
        Parameters:
        coordinates - the coordinates, in calibrated units in X Y Z
        radiiXYZ - the radii for each spot in X Y Z
        timepoints - the 0-based timepoints for each spot
        Returns:
        created spots
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error

      • find

        public static Imaris.ISpotsPrx find(String name,
                                    Imaris.IDataContainerPrx parent)
                             throws Imaris.Error
        Get the first Spots object with the given name
        Parameters:
        name - the name of the spots object to get. Returns the first spots object if there are multiple spots with the same name (Don't do that)
        parent - the parent object, a group
        Returns:
        the requested spots, null if not found

        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error Object

      • filter

        public static Imaris.ISpotsPrx filter(Imaris.ISpotsPrx spots,
                                      String columnName,
                                      double minValue,
                                      double maxValue)
                               throws Imaris.Error
        Returns an Imaris surface filtered with a test minValue < value > maxValue for a defined columnName
        Parameters:

        columnName - ColumnName as displayed in ImageJ Results Table you got from @EasyXT.Stats.export()
        minValue - the minimum value
        maxValue - the maximum value
        Returns:
        filteredSurface the filtered surface
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error
